about: Jerremy M. Ramp is an attorney providing legal services covering Family Law and Alternative Dispute Resolution.

Jerremy Ramp, who practices law in Denver, Colorado, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at University of Notre Dame Law School. He graduated in 2003. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 2004.
